# planetscale_neki_configuration_profile (Resource)

Manage an additional Neki shard configuration profile on a branch.
Creating a `planetscale_neki_branch` already provisions a default configuration profile. Import that profile if it needs to be managed; do not attempt to create it again.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String) Requires replacement if changed.
- `database` (String) Requires replacement if changed.
- `name` (String) The name of the shard configuration profile.
- `organization` (String) Requires replacement if changed.

### Optional

- `cluster_size` (String) The cluster size used by shards assigned to this profile.
- `postgres_major_version` (Number) The PostgreSQL major version used by this profile. Requires replacement if changed.
- `postgres_minor_version` (Number) The PostgreSQL minor version used by this profile. Requires replacement if changed.
- `replicas` (Number) The number of replicas for shards using this profile.

### Read-Only

- `architecture` (String) The architecture of the profile's cluster size.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the branch's default configuration profile.
- `metal` (Boolean) Whether shards using this profile run on metal instances.
- `shards` (Number) The number of shards assigned to this profile.
- `state` (String) The rollout state of the profile.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = planetscale_neki_configuration_profile.my_planetscale_neki_configuration_profile
  id = jsonencode({
    branch       = "..."
    database     = "..."
    name         = "..."
    organization = "..."
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import planetscale_neki_configuration_profile.my_planetscale_neki_configuration_profile '{"branch": "...", "database": "...", "name": "...", "organization": "..."}'
```
